rationale: Adds display-only modulated-value markers to Knob/Fader, bounds SvgPathWidget::set_path and CanvasWidget redraw repaints to the painted extent / own box, marks whole-surface damage for rect-less requests on plug-in hosts, and adds a header-only FrameCostProbe test helper. Repaint scope and widget paint only: no design-import, Chromium, rendering-backend or packaging authority moves.
